record.reason: The paper evaluates sparse binary Transformers on multivariate time-series classification, anomaly detection, and forecasting; fixed/causal attention masks plus binary weights reduce storage up to 53x and FLOPs up to 10.5x. The mechanisms are concrete but the evaluated domain is time-series rather than language-model inference.
record.title: Sparse Binary Transformers for Multivariate Time Series Modeling
